title: Add Persistent Command Chevron Button to Window Engagement
description: The command line engagement for each window should have a persistent chevron button (like the window options fold/unfold button) that is always visible. The input should move to the right of the button. The button shows Command label with a chevron icon.
summary: Restyled window engagement to match window options rail: GlassTierProvider windowOptions tier, frosted stack (windowMeasuresStackClass), chrome title bar (WindowEngagementChrome mirroring WindowMeasuresChrome), shared windowRailChromeLabelActionClass, top-left overlay with p-single, and engagement-zone glass CSS.
